verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only programmatic API access to parts of the cap table: capitalization table by share class, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes and fair market values (v1alpha1 endpoints). It never shows a self-serve Excel/CSV export of the full cap table or transaction history. A competitor founder also reports that Carta makes it hard to transfer your cap table elsewhere, which cuts against the 'never held hostage' part of the story but is not a concrete documented export failure. Missing for 10: a documented one-click Excel/CSV export of the complete cap table, a full transaction/ledger history export, evidence the export is available at any time including after cancellation, a stable non-alpha API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
